bindirs.description: Whitespace-delimited list of directories to search for binaries

libdirs.description: Whitespace-delimited list of directories to search for libraries

mandirs.description: Whitespace-delimited list of directories to search for manpages

path.description: Override PATH environment variable (empty string means use default)

tmpdir.description: Directory for temporary files (empty string means use default: TMPDIR or /tmp)

logfile.description: Path to output file instead of stdout (empty string means stdout)

debug.description: Enable debug mode (retain temp files in current directory)
